text:
dev_jess: Hey team — got an EDR popup a few mins ago: "High severity — suspicious setuid binary modified: /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper". EDR quarantined the file and sudo started failing for me. I pushed a quick screenshot here: https://redwood-internal/attachments/2112345678/screenshot.png

sec-ops-bot: [EDR] Alert created: ALERT-2112 | Host: host-9a7 | Artifact: art-9a7-2112 | Action: quarantined -> vault://edr/art-9a7-2112 | SHA256: 3f5b1c9a7e4d2a1f6b2c9d8e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9

maria_sec: @dev_jess can you confirm you didn't run any root-level scripts that modify setuid bits? Do NOT reboot. Isolate host via EDR if available.

dev_jess: I ran `sudo apt update` and a `docker build` earlier for the feature branch, no deliberate chmod +s. Running `ls -l /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper` and `sha256sum /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper` now:
```
-rwsr-xr-x 1 root root 14232 Mar 2 10:12 /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper
3f5b1c9a7e4d2a1f6b2c9d8e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9  /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper
```

ajay_r: On it — can you run `sudo -l` output? and paste last auth lines: `tail -n 50 /var/log/auth.log` (or `journalctl -u sudo` on systemd). Also grab `ps aux | grep sudo-helper` to see if it's running.

dev_jess: `sudo -l` returns normal (no surprises). `ps` shows nothing for sudo-helper. auth.log excerpt: `Mar 2 10:11:39 host-9a7 sudo: pam_unix(sudo:session): session opened for user root by dev_jess(uid=0)` then at 10:12:05 EDR logged file write to /usr/local/bin/sudo-helper by PID 3210 (unowned process).

maria_sec: Good catch — that PID needs investigation. Do NOT restore binary to path. ajay, can you pull EDR collection (full memory + file) and upload to sandbox? Use artifact art-9a7-2112. Also check CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs for any KMS Decrypt or IAM AssumeRole calls by `dev_jess`'s principal in the 30 mins around 10:00-10:30. We need to know if any secrets were used.

ajay_r: EDR collection started (collect-id: coll-2112-9a7). Uploaded binary to sandbox: https://sandbox/submit/art-9a7-2112. Quick cloud check: no KMS Decrypt events for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/dev_jess` in that window. There are a couple of `ListKeys` calls from CI IPs but not decrypts.

maria_sec: That's better (no decrypts). Still treat as compromise until proven otherwise. We'll escalate to IR. Recommended next steps: 1) Keep host isolated (EDR isolate) 2) Schedule reimage/rebuild for host-9a7 3) Rotate any ephemeral creds used on that machine (docker tokens, kube tokens) and audit service accounts that `dev_jess` has access to. 4) Add an audit rule to detect setuid bit changes under /usr/local/bin and /opt. 5) Create follow-up ticket to review RBAC — restrict who can write to /usr/local/bin.

dev_jess: Host isolation in progress via EDR UI. I'm not seeing any unusual git/push activity. I'll list docker containers & images and share.

ajay_r: Collected container list: `docker ps -a` showed a stopped build container from 09:50. Images: no suspicious images with `malicious` tag. Also checked `~/.docker/config.json` — no active auths except our CI token. Recommend rotating CI token used recently as precaution.

maria_sec: Agreed. Also please check local SSH agent forwarding usage on that host — if forwarding was on, rotate keys that might have been forwarded. For KMS/HSM note: we saw no KMS Decrypts, but will keep monitoring for any subsequent decrypt events tied to this artifact. If sandbox analysis shows key-exfil attempt, we'll escalate to rotate KMS keys.

sec-ops-bot: [IR] Incident created INC-2021-SUDOHELPER. P1 -> IR oncall pinged.

maria_sec: IR recommends reimage. Assigning to infra for rebuild and to dev_jess for credential rotation checklist. I'll create post-incident follow-up doc and include indicators: sha256 3f5b1c9a..., artifact link, host-9a7, suspect PID 3210, timeline.

ajay_r: Quick IOC sweep across fleet for matching sha256 and filename pattern `/usr/local/bin/sudo-helper` returned 0 matches beyond host-9a7. Will rerun after containment.

dev_jess: Reimage scheduled for next maintenance window (in 2 hours) — will back up work. Thanks for quick help. :thumbsup:

maria_sec: Good. After reimage we'll close with postmortem: root cause, how file got there, what RBAC/gating to add, and check KMS integration settings (logging & alerting on Decrypt api). For action items: ajay to upload sandbox report, infra to reimage, dev_jess to rotate tokens, maria to open postmortem doc.

ajay_r: Upload complete — sandbox flagged the binary as a custom wrapper with network calls to `34.82.1.9:443` immediately after exec. Blocked domain & added to AWL. I'll attach the sandbox report in the PM doc.

maria_sec: Perfect. We'll keep this thread updated with reimage status & PM link.

dev_jess: Copy — standing by.
